items.text: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Super VL, an open multimodal model designed for nonstop enterprise-agent workloads.
items.text_zh: 英伟达发布 Nemotron 3.5 Super VL 开放多模态模型，面向持续运行的企业智能体。
items.cat_take_en: Its open release lowers the barrier for enterprise teams building always-on multimodal agents, but deployment costs remain unclear.
items.cat_take_zh: 开放权重降低了企业构建多模态智能体的门槛，但持续运行成本仍未明朗。

items.text: Krea opened its Krea 3 beta, promising native 2K image edits in under eight seconds with LoRA and style-reference support.
items.text_zh: Krea 开放 Krea 3 测试版，支持原生 2K 图像编辑、LoRA 与风格参考，处理时间低于八秒。
items.cat_take_en: Sub-eight-second 2K editing targets professional iteration speed, though the beta’s quality claims still await broader benchmarks.
items.cat_take_zh: 八秒内完成 2K 编辑直击专业迭代效率，但测试版质量仍需更多独立基准验证。

items.text: ElevenLabs said blind listeners preferred its Eleven v4 voice model over competing systems across eight languages.
items.text_zh: ElevenLabs 表示，盲测听众在八种语言中都更偏好其 Eleven v4 语音模型。
items.cat_take_en: The multilingual result strengthens ElevenLabs’ creator positioning, but the company-run test leaves independent reproduction unresolved.
items.cat_take_zh: 多语言结果强化了其创作者定位，但测试由公司主导，独立复现仍是悬念。

items.text: Kling 4.0 became fully available through Kling’s refreshed creation interface, expanding access to its latest video-generation tools.
items.text_zh: Kling 4.0 通过全新创作界面正式全面开放，用户可直接使用最新视频生成工具。
items.cat_take_en: Full availability shifts Kling from showcase to production tool, increasing pressure on rivals to match creator workflow polish.
items.cat_take_zh: 全面开放让 Kling 从展示模型进入生产工具阶段，竞争焦点将转向创作流程体验。

items.text: Luma introduced Shot Coverage, which turns one video shot into additional moving camera angles for editing.
items.text_zh: Luma 推出 Shot Coverage，可将单个视频镜头转换为多个可剪辑的运动机位。
items.cat_take_en: Generating coverage from existing footage can cut reshoot costs, but consistency across invented angles will determine professional adoption.
items.cat_take_zh: 从现有素材补拍机位可能降低重拍成本，但虚拟角度的一致性决定能否进入专业制作。

items.text: Sakana AI unveiled The Agentic Scientist, a system that orchestrates coding agents for automated scientific co-discovery.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 发布 Agentic Scientist，用编码智能体协同推进自动化科学发现。
items.cat_take_en: The system moves AI research beyond paper summarization toward experiment loops, while validation and attribution remain difficult.
items.cat_take_zh: 该系统把 AI 从论文总结推进到实验闭环，但成果验证与贡献归属仍很棘手。

items.text: Cognition introduced Devin Oncall, which investigates alerts and bugs and connects with Datadog, Dynatrace, Sentry, and similar tools.
items.text_zh: Cognition 推出 Devin Oncall，可调查告警与缺陷，并连接 Datadog、Dynatrace、Sentry 等工具。
items.cat_take_en: Integrating directly with observability stacks gives Devin a concrete production role, but autonomous remediation still needs strict controls.
items.cat_take_zh: 直接接入可观测性系统让 Devin 获得明确生产场景，但自动修复仍需严格权限控制。

items.text: Manus launched Automations, allowing users to schedule agent runs or trigger them from connected-app events.
items.text_zh: Manus 推出 Automations，支持按时间运行智能体，或由连接应用中的事件触发任务。
items.cat_take_en: Event-triggered agents turn Manus into workflow infrastructure, but reliability across long-running external actions is the key test.
items.cat_take_zh: 事件触发让 Manus 更像工作流基础设施，但跨应用长期执行的可靠性才是关键。

items.text: World Labs began rolling out Atlas beta access, including pixel-precise camera-path control for generated 3D worlds.
items.text_zh: World Labs 开始推送 Atlas 测试资格，并提供对生成式三维世界的像素级镜头路径控制。
items.cat_take_en: Precise camera control addresses a major weakness of generative worlds, making Atlas more useful for directed production than demos.
items.cat_take_zh: 精确镜头控制补上了生成式世界的关键短板，使 Atlas 更接近定向制作工具。

items.text: Google DeepMind described using Antigravity to accelerate antimicrobial-peptide discovery through AI-guided scientific search.
items.text_zh: Google DeepMind 介绍 Antigravity 如何通过 AI 引导科学搜索，加速抗菌肽发现。
items.cat_take_en: The work points to a high-value use of AI beyond chat, though laboratory validation remains the unavoidable bottleneck.
items.cat_take_zh: 这展示了 AI 超越聊天的高价值用途，但实验室验证仍是无法绕过的瓶颈。

items.text: AWS expanded Strands Decider with four Gemma sizes ranging from two billion to 26 billion parameters for agent routing decisions.
items.text_zh: AWS 为 Strands Decider 增加四种 Gemma 规模，覆盖二十亿至二百六十亿参数，用于智能体路由决策。
items.cat_take_en: Small routing models can reduce latency and cost, giving developers a practical alternative to sending every decision to frontier models.
items.cat_take_zh: 小型路由模型可降低延迟与成本，让开发者不必把每个决策都交给前沿模型。

items.text: Ideogram 4.5 added multi-turn editing at every price tier, with native 2K output ranging from $0.008 to $0.22 per image.
items.text_zh: Ideogram 4.5 在所有价格档位提供多轮编辑与原生 2K 输出，单张成本约为 0.008 至 0.22 美元。
items.cat_take_en: A wide price-performance ladder could broaden serious image editing, while users must trade speed and quality against budget.
items.cat_take_zh: 覆盖多档价格有望扩大专业图像编辑用户，但速度、质量与预算仍需取舍。

items.text: Archestra released OpenAPPA, a framework designed to reduce data leakage caused by prompt injection and model hallucinations.
items.text_zh: Archestra 发布 OpenAPPA，旨在降低提示词注入和模型幻觉引发的数据泄露风险。
items.cat_take_en: Treating prompt injection as an application-layer security problem is useful, but no framework eliminates unsafe tool permissions.
items.cat_take_zh: 把提示词注入视为应用层安全问题很有价值，但框架无法替代危险工具权限治理。

items.text: Pi introduced a new Agent Harness and integrated MCP into its core despite previously criticizing the protocol.
items.text_zh: Pi 推出全新 Agent Harness，并将此前长期批评的 MCP 纳入核心架构。
items.cat_take_en: Embedding MCP signals that interoperability now outweighs Pi’s earlier architectural objections.
items.cat_take_zh: 把 MCP 纳入核心，说明代理互操作性已压过 Pi 早期的架构质疑。

items.text: Linus Torvalds used Claude Code on the Linux kernel, but the generated patch still contained a bug that required manual correction.
items.text_zh: Linus Torvalds 用 Claude Code 修改 Linux 内核，但生成的补丁仍包含需要人工修正的漏洞。
items.cat_take_en: The episode limits coding-agent hype: even kernel experts still need rigorous review of machine-generated patches.
items.cat_take_zh: 这次事件压低了编程代理的乐观预期：内核专家仍必须严格审查机器生成的补丁。

items.text: Pizza Bot is an open-source AI inbox designed to help teams process and respond to backend operational messages.
items.text_zh: Pizza Bot 是一个开源后台 AI 收件箱，帮助团队处理并回复运营消息。
items.cat_take_en: Its value is operational focus: narrow inbox automation may deliver faster reliability gains than general-purpose agents.
items.cat_take_zh: 它的价值在于场景聚焦：窄领域收件箱自动化或比通用代理更快带来可靠性收益。

items.text: Alibaba’s Taobao TEKO describes an autonomous write-verify-repair loop for checking and correcting AI-generated code.
items.text_zh: 阿里手淘 TEKO 介绍了一个自主“写—验—修”闭环，用于检查并修正 AI 生成的代码。
items.cat_take_en: The verification loop attacks the main weakness of coding agents: producing plausible code without dependable execution evidence.
items.cat_take_zh: 验证闭环直击编程代理的核心弱点：代码看似合理，却缺少可靠的执行证据。

items.text: RealtimeBench evaluates agents on 180 tasks across six game types while environments continue changing during inference.
items.text_zh: RealtimeBench 在六类游戏的 180 项任务中评估推理期间仍持续变化环境里的代理。
items.cat_take_en: The benchmark exposes a practical gap: strong paused-game scores can collapse when latency becomes part of the task.
items.cat_take_zh: 该基准揭示现实差距：暂停环境中的高分，可能在延迟成为任务条件后迅速失效。

items.text: A benchmark-saturation study found that solving transcripts retain capability signals, with pairwise judging reducing prediction error 5.3 times versus score-only baselines.
items.text_zh: 一项基准饱和研究发现，解题过程仍保留能力信号；成对评判比只看分数的基线将预测误差降低 5.3 倍。
items.cat_take_en: This gives saturated benchmarks a second life, but distribution shifts still make transcript-based comparisons fragile.
items.cat_take_zh: 这让饱和基准获得第二次生命，但分布变化仍会削弱基于过程的能力比较。

items.text: VISTA selects diffusion guidance timesteps with dynamic programming and cut toxic-text generation latency from 204.23 to 38.16 seconds.
items.text_zh: VISTA 用动态规划选择扩散引导时间步，并将有害文本生成延迟从 204.23 秒降至 38.16 秒。
items.cat_take_en: The 5.35× speedup makes reward-guided generation more deployable, though warmup sampling remains an added cost.
items.cat_take_zh: 5.35 倍加速提升了奖励引导生成的部署可行性，但预热采样仍会增加额外成本。

items.text: AlphaDiana proposes a measurement system for evaluating agents on verifiable reasoning tasks.
items.text_zh: AlphaDiana 提出了一套用于评估可验证推理任务中代理表现的测量系统。
items.cat_take_en: Verifiable tasks shift agent evaluation toward auditable outcomes rather than persuasive but uncheckable reasoning traces.
items.cat_take_zh: 可验证任务把代理评估推向可审计结果，而不是令人信服却无法核验的推理痕迹。

items.text: A Verus study reports that correctness feedback can erase evidence, motivating phase-separated completeness audits for formally verified code.
items.text_zh: 一项 Verus 研究指出，正确性反馈可能抹除证据，因此需要分阶段审计形式化验证代码的完整性。
items.cat_take_en: The result warns that passing checks can reduce visibility into what was never checked, a serious software-assurance risk.
items.cat_take_zh: 研究警告：通过检查可能反而掩盖未检查部分，构成严肃的软件保障风险。

items.text: Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields provide evidence-grounded selective safety for vision-language models.
items.text_zh: Counterfactual Neighborhood Risk Fields 为视觉语言模型提供基于证据的选择性安全机制。
items.cat_take_en: Selective safeguards could reduce unnecessary refusals, but their safety depends on counterfactual evidence remaining trustworthy.
items.cat_take_zh: 选择性防护有望减少不必要拒答，但安全性取决于反事实证据是否可信。

items.text: IneqAgent combines agentic search with symbolic computation to prove inequality theorems in Lean.
items.text_zh: IneqAgent 将代理式搜索与符号计算结合，用于在 Lean 中证明不等式定理。
items.cat_take_en: Symbolic tools give theorem-proving agents a verifiable backbone, narrowing the gap between fluent proposals and certified mathematics.
items.cat_take_zh: 符号工具为定理证明代理提供可验证骨架，缩小流畅猜测与数学认证之间的鸿沟。

items.text: L2G-SR studies how to guide LLM-based symbolic regression toward discovering interpretable equations.
items.text_zh: L2G-SR 研究如何引导基于大语言模型的符号回归发现可解释方程。
items.cat_take_en: Interpretability is the practical upside: equations can be inspected and tested instead of accepted as opaque predictions.
items.cat_take_zh: 它的实际优势在于可解释性：方程能够被检查和测试，而不是被当作黑箱预测接受。

items.text: Causal analysis of robot foundation models identifies efficiency gains without relying only on larger-scale training.
items.text_zh: 一项机器人基础模型研究通过因果分析寻找效率收益，而不是只依赖更大规模训练。
items.cat_take_en: Causal diagnostics could lower robotics data and compute costs, benefiting labs that cannot match frontier-scale budgets.
items.cat_take_zh: 因果诊断有望降低机器人数据与算力成本，尤其利好无法匹敌前沿预算的实验室。

items.text: Multi-dimensional featurizers enable fine-grained steering and data shaping for robot foundation models.
items.text_zh: 多维特征提取器让机器人基础模型能够进行更细粒度的控制与数据塑形。
items.cat_take_en: More precise steering could make robot datasets more reusable, but it also increases the burden of feature design and validation.
items.cat_take_zh: 更精细的控制有望提高机器人数据复用率，但也会增加特征设计与验证负担。

items.text: The Agentic Scientist report describes agents coordinating coding work for automated scientific co-discovery and interpretability experiments.
items.text_zh: 《Agentic Scientist》介绍了协调编码工作的代理系统，用于自动化科学共发现与可解释性实验。
items.cat_take_en: Delegating experiment plumbing to agents could expand researcher throughput, while reproducibility becomes the decisive constraint.
items.cat_take_zh: 把实验工程交给代理可提升研究吞吐量，但可复现性将成为决定性约束。
